en.title: Carrot, Broccoli, Corn! 🥕🌽 | Veggie Dance Song for Toddlers | Momo Time
en.description:
Wiggle with carrot, bounce with broccoli, and tap along with corn! Sing a short happy chorus with Momo.

Three veggie words for ages 2–4: CARROT · BROCCOLI · CORN. Simple repeated singing and a cheerful dance.

#MomoTime #ToddlerSongs #VegetableSong #Carrot #Broccoli #Corn #KidsSongs #SingAlong

notes.reviewer: agent; no new individual user approval
notes.v_over_reason: Current short-song policy: reuse six approved non-lipsync sources, recut to the new song. No fixed spoken intro/outro.
approvals: 2026-11-27 agent visual review of ep03 approved sources; identity and moving food subjects suitable for current keyword-only production.

composition.style: Original English preschool singalong in lively lilting 6/8 meter, dotted-quarter 104 BPM, sunny major key. One clear light warm female lead with crisp easy English. Bright pizzicato strings, small accordion, soft hand drum and wooden taps; natural gentle energy. Independent original melody, rocking two-beat phrases, a falling third then a bright upward skip in the hook. Short repeated four-line chorus with room for children to echo. Fully sung, not rap or spoken. Around 90 seconds, vocal entrance within 2 seconds, short intro, complete final phrase and resolved two-second musical ending. No source melody or cover.

review_summary.song: Approved after official listening, stem alignment and melody-contour comparison. See music-review.json.

notes.validation_review: No validation errors. Legacy V/S/L and intro/narration warnings superseded by current song-only no-lipsync policy. Object-only close-ups intentionally have momo:false. Combined keywords are three food nouns separated by dots; no sentence captions.
notes.thumbnail_review: Initial three-word thumbnail obscured vegetables. Revised to one clear learning word above an unobstructed carrot close-up.
notes.final_frame_correction: Agent final-frame correction: use c06 from 0.28 s so Momo and Ducky finish with feet down near source 3.98 s, without any frozen extension.
